# Canada Life

> > Canada Life provides insurance, retirement savings, and investment solutions for individuals, families, and businesses across Canada.

Canada Life offers comprehensive financial products including life, health, dental, and disability insurance, workplace benefits programs, retirement planning tools (RRSPs, TFSAs, group retirement plans), and mortgage services through partnerships. The company emphasizes employee wellness, mental health support, and income protection solutions aligned with Canadian government programs like CPP, QPP, and Employment Insurance.

## Key Topics

- Canada Pension Plan (CPP) and Quebec Pension Plan (QPP)
- Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP)
- Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA)
- Freedom to Choose health insurance
- Workplace benefits and employee wellness
- Mental health support programs
- Disability insurance (short-term and long-term)
- Income protection and replacement
- Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) regulations
- Employment Insurance (EI)
- Provincial health coverage variations
- Group retirement savings plans
- Employee assistance programs
- Return-to-work support
- Mortgage solutions and trigger rates
